description: Encodes text, a URL, a wallet address or a payment URI (ethereum:, solana:) into a QR code, returned as scalable SVG and a GIF data URL. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

ecc.description: Error correction L, M, Q or H

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: qr_code
